My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
I'm sorry to hear your order arrived damaged. Here's what to do:
Document the Damage:
Take clear photos of the damaged packaging itself
Take photos of the entire product and close-ups of the affected areas (like punctures or indentations)
Include a common object near the damaged area to show scale
Photograph the law tag showing the barcode (both front and back if available)
Note the unboxing date
Contact Our Support Team:
Email the photos and a description of the damage to our support team, along with your order details, email, and current shipping address. The team will review your documentation and guide you through the next steps.
You should receive a confirmation email within 12-72 hours after reporting. Processing time for replacement requests may take up to 7 business days (not including any production time needed to make the item).
If a replacement is approved, you can continue using the damaged item while waiting, and the current item will be removed when the replacement is delivered.
Would you like me to connect you with a team member to start this process right away?
